opportunities.title: Institutional Engagement Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applications must be supported by a Society Representative or a Fellow.
opportunities.summary: Provides funding to support Society Representatives and members to host events at their organisation, including internal conferences, teaching symposia, seminars or outreach events.

opportunities.title: Unlocking Futures Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to postdoctoral researchers who require additional support to help them achieve their full potential. Members will normally only be awarded this funding once during their period of membership.
opportunities.summary: Provides additional support to postdoctoral researchers to help them achieve their full potential, started in memory of Professor Hisako Ikeda-Wolstencroft. Funds can be used for consumables, HEA Fellowship registration and other justified sundries, not staff salaries.

opportunities.title: Education and Teaching Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to members wishing to develop new educational resources or conduct a piece of publishable educational research addressing a key question in physiological education.
opportunities.summary: Supports members wishing to develop new educational resources or conduct publishable educational research in physiological education.

opportunities.title: Research and Knowledge Exchange Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to members wishing to conduct pilot studies, develop a new technique or finalise a project, as well as supporting activities to promote knowledge transfer and impact. Applications should be physiological in nature.
opportunities.summary: Supports members wishing to conduct pilot studies, develop a new technique or finalise a project, as well as activities to promote knowledge transfer and impact.

opportunities.title: Equity, Diversity and Inclusion Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to members to run activities addressing equity, diversity and inclusion principles. Applicants must be an Undergraduate & Masters, Postgraduate, Full member or Fellow of the Society in their second year of membership or longer.
opportunities.summary: Provides support for Members to run activities that address equity, diversity and inclusion principles in the physiological sciences.
